data.name: SetupSubtitle
data.value: Point Forza Horizon at this PC. The checklist updates live as soon as the game sends data.

data.name: SetupSamePcTitle
data.value: The game runs on this PC

data.name: SetupOtherDeviceBody
data.value: Type the address shown above. Both devices must be on the same network.

data.name: SetupInGameStep1
data.value: Open Settings, then HUD and Gameplay.

data.name: SetupInGameStep3
data.value: Enter the IP address and the port from the left.

data.name: SetupListeningPending
data.value: The app is not listening yet.

data.name: SetupListeningOk
data.value: Ready to receive data from the game.

data.name: SetupListeningReplay
data.value: A recording is playing, not the game. Stop the replay to listen.

data.name: SetupNetworkPrivate
data.value: Windows treats this network as Private, so incoming game data is allowed.

data.name: SetupNetworkDomain
data.value: Windows treats this network as a Domain network.

data.name: SetupNetworkPublic
data.value: Public networks block incoming game data. Switch it to Private (steps below).

data.name: SetupNetworkPublicWorks
data.value: This network is Public, but data is getting through anyway.

data.name: SetupNetworkUnknown
data.value: Could not be checked. It only matters if no packets arrive.

data.name: SetupPacketsWarning
data.value: Nothing has arrived after {0} seconds. Check the list below.

data.name: SetupDrivingPending
data.value: Waiting for you to drive. Menus and the pause screen do not send driving data.

data.name: SetupTroubleIp
data.value: The IP in the game is exactly the one shown here, or 127.0.0.1 when the game runs on this PC.

data.name: SetupTroubleFirewall
data.value: Windows Firewall allows incoming UDP on this port. The installer adds the rule for Private networks.

data.name: SetupTroubleVpn
data.value: A VPN can block local network access. Pause it or allow LAN access.

data.name: SetupTroubleSubnet
data.value: The console and this PC are on the same network and subnet (not a guest Wi-Fi, not another router).

data.name: SetupTroubleDriving
data.value: The game is in a drive: Data Out sends nothing from menus and loading screens.

data.name: SetupConnectedBody
data.value: Live driving data is arriving from the game.

data.name: SetupDashboardHint
data.value: Not receiving data from the game yet.

data.name: SetupGuideHint
data.value: A step-by-step guide with a live checklist of what is working.
